result.question: What happens to Uzziah when he seeks Yahweh?

readings.support: as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success

readings.answer: He is instructed in the fear of God.
readings.support: He sought God throughout the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God.

assessments.reason: The passage states, “as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success,” which matches “God made him prosper.”
The instruction in the fear of God is attributed to Zechariah and not presented as what happens when Uzziah seeks Yahweh; the text links seeking the LORD to God giving him success.

result.reason: The text explicitly connects Uzziah’s seeking the LORD with God giving him success, matching the key.
